findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "identify_address" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: exit_cost · Private data: exit_cost, coin_profile, powermap, exit_index, identify_address, explain_transaction · Public sink: exit_index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: exit_cost · Private data: exit_cost, coin_profile, powermap, exit_index, identify_address, explain_transaction · Public sink: exit_index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
